description: Recommends aluminum-clad wood windows for Bowerman House.
Balances heritage preservation with budget and maintenance.
Emphasizes qualified contractor for window installation.
Notes precedent concerns for future heritage replacements.

chips.text: Approved
Councillor questioned if PVC replacement goes against heritage preservation.
Meewasin Valley Authority manages Bowerman House and funds part of the project.
Committee will provide a letter with its recommendation to Administration.

segments.title: Staff Presentation on Bowerman House Window Replacement
segments.takeaway: Staff presented the Bowerman House's heritage value, current rental use, and the need to replace eight south-facing windows due to their end of life.

segments.title: Committee Questions on Window Materials and Costs
segments.takeaway: Committee members questioned the use of PVC over wood for heritage preservation, discussing cost, maintenance, and the aesthetic impact of different window materials.

segments.title: Discussion on Installation and Long-term Heritage Impact
segments.takeaway: The committee emphasized the critical importance of proper installation by skilled contractors and discussed the long-term impact of material choices on the house's heritage character.

segments.title: Committee Recommendation and Motion
segments.takeaway: The committee recommended exploring aluminum-clad, dual-pane, single-hung windows and moved to draft a letter detailing their feedback for administration.
